_comment: Targeted corpus quotas (P2-4). Starting points from the generator plan; the patch rounds (P2-7, P2-9) retune them HERE so every change is reviewable.

families._comment: P2-4c added `inflected` (sentences with a suffixed name, surname, city or street). 60% of those labels' mentions sit in table cells, which take no suffix, so the 35-40% target needs its own documents; the other shares were trimmed to make room.
families._comment_p2_4d: P2-4d added `minimal` (1-5 word documents) and `homograph` (the same word as a name and as an ordinary word), ~5% each as the task asks. Lone lowercase words in `minimal` have no entity, so `pii_free` is trimmed to keep the PII-free share at ~10%.
families._comment_d34: D-34g added `form` (3-5 `Label: value` lines mixing real values and look-alikes): Run B's data held 1-15% look-alikes in that slot. Taken from `prose`, whose single-entity documents stay far above their 25% target.
families._comment_d34_g2: D-34 group 2 added `clerical` (long semicolon chains with one value or look-alike, D-33f single_entity/prose_card/prose_iban) and `village` (village names before `kənd` or suffixed, with control sentences, D-33f villages), both from `prose`. A look-alike clerical chain and most public-key documents (contrast.key_pair) are PII-free, so `pii_free` gives 0.025 back to hold the 10% target.
families._comment_d34_g3: D-34 group 3 added `punct` (values glued to punctuation, D-33f punct_touching), 0.02 from `prose`.
families._comment_d39b: D-39b added `namelist` (0.03): official name lists with patronymics, names after a lowercase role word, signature lines, sentence-initial names, a name after an organisation (shapes of the given names Run B missed in real text). Taken from contrast, form, clerical and pii_free (0.005 each) and inflected (0.01).
families._comment_d35a: D-35a: `form` 0.04 -> 0.08 for DATE look-alikes in `label: value` lines (1.8% across v3's sources, target ~10%), from prose (0.02), structured and inflected (0.01 each). decoy_pair is untouched: its name and building groups sit at their 5% floors.
families._comment_d42c: D-42c (shadow shapes) added `postal` (0.015: bare 4-digit ZIPs in their contexts) and `edges` (0.02: VÖEN, passport and building numbers glued to punctuation, or after a document noun or verb). Taken from contrast (0.015), form, clerical, village and structured (0.005 each).
families._comment_d51h: D-51h (v4 targeted data, v3_coverage_report section 5) adds `cross_anchor` (0.04: look-alikes in other labels' slots -- short numbers after VÖEN/FİN/vəsiqə/token/API words, company names and codes after soyad/şəhər/küçə, room and door codes, MAC and IBAN fragments, IPv4 shapes, ZIP-shaped product codes -- each beside a real value), `locative` (0.0165: a value after a locative document noun, right before the verb), `slot_invalid` (0.0125: invalid times, ages, dates, FINs and wrong-length cards right after their label word, beside a valid one), `place_verbs` (0.01: suffixed towns and ablative surnames in verbs that also take people) and `short_keys` (0.01: short Ed25519 private keys, >= 3 per Ed25519 public look-alike). `pem_long` 0.0055 -> 0.0125 keeps D-27's >= 30% real-length keys with the extra short keys. Taken from decoy_pair (0.2545 -> 0.23; its name and building groups go 0.20 -> 0.22 to stay at their 5% floors), contrast (0.02), form, inflected (0.01 each: slot_invalid and place_verbs take their lessons), prose, clerical, punct, minimal, homograph (0.005 each), village, edges (0.0025 each) and postal (0.0015).
families._comment_v41_a5: v4.1 A5 (v3_shadow_shapes.md leads 3-5): `key_placeholder` 0.008 (private-key blocks with a placeholder body), postal 0.0135 -> 0.02 (bare ZIPs after a town with no index word), pii_free 0.06 -> 0.07 (A5: PII-free documents masked), namelist 0.03 -> 0.035 (its new line_start construction). Taken from prose (0.0095), clerical, minimal, homograph and cross_anchor (0.005 each; cross_anchor also carries the IPv4 look-alikes of v4.1 task 1, H3). structured and decoy_pair stay at their floors. pem_long 0.0125 -> 0.0145 (from prose): the real keys beside the placeholder blocks are short, and D-27 needs >= 30% of private keys at real length (it read 30.0% without this).
families._comment_v41_generator: v4.1 generator (D-52b-d): the targeted build grows to 28,000 documents (D-52d). Shares are per document, so a family keeps its 25k document count at 28k with its share x 25/28 -- every family below does, except: decoy_pair and inflected keep their shares (not cut, D-52d); structured, minimal, homograph and pii_free stay above their --stats floors; contrast holds the protected ipv6_mac and licence_id sub-families at 585 per 25k (D-52d) with token_key and key_pair at their counts; form and slot_invalid rise for the C4 look-alike kinds (form 0.06 -> 0.068 for the protected dates and ZIP look-alikes, with pii_free 0.07 -> 0.06: PII-free documents stay inside 10% +- 2); net_context is new (#91 item 1); prose and clerical take the rest back (#92).
families._comment_time_seconds: v3_shadow_shapes.md lead 1 (15 Oct) adds `time_seconds` (0.02: labelled times with seconds in prose, `Saat:` fields, ranges and chat lines, beside unlabelled chat/log line stamps, D-51f). Taken from contrast (0.015) and inflected (0.005); structured stays at its 15% floor and decoy_pair's groups at their 5% floors.
families._comment_v42: v4.2 fix list (19 Oct): the build grows 28,000 -> 30,000. structured, minimal, homograph, pii_free, decoy_pair, inflected (share-based floors), contrast, form, slot_invalid (per-25k protected kinds) and time_seconds (item 6: seconds-times in ranges) keep their shares, so their counts grow; slot_invalid itself 0.013 -> 0.03 (A5 and C4 look-alikes in their label slot). Every other family keeps its 28k count (share x 28/30); prose and clerical stay about 5% under theirs, so the shares sum to 1 at a round 30,000.
families._comment_d57: D-57 (v4.2 final fix list, 20 Oct): the build grows 30,000 -> 37,000. The families with a share floor or a per-25k protected quota keep their shares (decoy_pair, contrast, form, structured, pii_free, inflected, minimal, homograph, slot_invalid, time_seconds) and most new content goes inside them (noun FIN/date pairs, age pairs and building variants in decoy_pair; CVV/VÖEN/passport lines in form; IPv6/MAC extras in contrast; ALL-CAPS forms in structured; near misses in pii_free). contrast 0.0712 -> 0.077 (S7: ipv6_mac and licence_id >= 600 per 25k, 640 now); postal back to v4.1's share (S7); pem_long now keeps its share too (D-27's >= 30% real-length keys had 2 points of margin, and contrast's key pairs grow); new pii_free_business 0.02 (M2: PII-free 6% -> 8%) and recall (S5/S6). Every other family keeps its 30k count (share x 30/37). minimal and homograph 0.038 -> 0.0362 (their --stats floor is 3.5%; their counts still grow) for recall, whose backfill items keep every label x context count at or above v4.2; pii_free 0.06 -> 0.0583 for the same (its count still grows; PII-free stays at ~10% with pii_free_business).

pii_free_business._comment: D-57 M2 + item 5 (builder._family_pii_free_business, frames_v42 BIZ_* and GEO): kinds, each sub-kind's weight (geography: the item 5, place-like words in a PII-free text); near_rate, a document's chance of one near-miss `Field: value` line (M1)

recall._comment: D-57 S5/S6 (builder._family_recall): 3-5 real values per document, items weighted by their per-25k targets -- an access token in prose (S5 ~250 with the cells), a CVV (240: decoy_pair's smaller `cvv` group, and v4.1's 595 per 25k mid-sentence) and a card mid-sentence (S5), `saat X radələrində` (+100), 23:5x / 00:0x (by turns), `24:00` (a real time, D-57), a leap year's 29 February (>= 100)
recall._backfill_comment: D-57's last rule (no real-value count per label and context goes down against v4.2): ipv4_prose ... key_inline restore what decoy_pair's smaller `other` group held (IPv4 in prose and after a label, passports, MACs after a label) and give the small cells a margin over sampling noise

decoy_noun_labels._comment: D-57: the label of a `noun` pair (the value before its noun), weighted: DATE most (M4: Feb 30/31 and month 13-19 before `tarixində`/`tarixli`, ~200 per 25k; C4's three date triggers were there; builder.NOUN_DATE_KINDS by turns), AZ_FIN new (M3: look-alikes before `FİN-i`, ~80)

decoy_building._comment: D-57 S4 (builder._building_pair): a building pair's chance of a street name then the number (`Nizami küçəsi 45`, the street labelled), of `ev {v}`, else `bina {v}`; lines_rate, of `Bina: 45` / `Ünvan: ... 45` lines beside an `Otaq: 12` line
decoy_building._ev_comment: the D-57 review, D: `ev` only beside a floor, in the courier and customer-registration frames, never in `Bina:` lines (else `bina`); ev_rate 0.15 -> 0.45 keeps `ev 7` in the data at about the same count

decoy_age._comment: D-57 S1 (builder._age_pair): a pair document's chance of a second real 2-digit age in a sentence of its own

net_context._comment: v4.1 (#91 item 1 b-c): builder._family_net_context -- real IPv6/IPv4/MAC in log/record prose beside unlabelled dotted codes. label_weights, each label's share of the real values; ipv6_compressed_rate, an IPv6's chance of the `::` form
net_context._layout_comment: D-56a (1): how a real value is written: a prose sentence (which may end open, ipv4.open_end_rate), a chat line or a log line that ends on the value

kind_weights._comment: D-52d: weights in the least-used kind choice (count / weight; 1 by default). The protected C4 kinds weigh more, so new kinds can't dilute them again (v4: each fell 8-43% as D-51h's kinds joined the rotation); policy_sequential_time (D-52c) weighs less so it doesn't take the time look-alikes' turns
kind_weights._ipv4_comment: the three IPv4 kinds D-51h added (#91 items 2-3): IPv4 took four turns in every rotation instead of one, so IPv4 look-alikes tripled (132 -> 412 per 25k) and outnumbered real IPv4 in prose
kind_weights._d56a_comment: D-56a (2), the IPv4 swing (v4 -> v4.1 note: benchmark IPv4 precision 95.1 -> 76.3, `256.1.1.1` and `1.2.3.4` masked): ipv4_short_over_255 (one octet over 255, three one-digit) 0.5 -> 1.5, new ipv4_over_255_mixed (`318.15.0.5`) 1.0, new policy_sequential_ipv4 (`1.2.3.4`-type dummies, as D-52c) 0.6
kind_weights._v42_comment: v4.2 fix list (19 Oct; v41_shadow_shapes.md): ipv4_three_octets 0.5 -> 1.5 (v4.1 trained on 43 in all and masked `99.99.9` 29 times; the kind only shares IPv4's turns, the real : look-alike ratio is held by a second real IPv4 in the IPv4 slot); the near-miss time kinds 2.6, the protected far kinds 2.6 -> 3.0 (margin over their 178 floor in small builds); the near-miss dates 0.58 and the absurd ISO dates 1.0 -> 0.4, and the protected date kinds 1.15 -> 1.25, so the protected date kinds keep 1,390 per 25k; zip_wrong_length 6.0 -> 9.0 (form gives a third line to dates, and small builds read 506-544 per 25k against the 559 floor); iban_short_account and licence_three_letters are A5's IBAN and licence groups; fin_dummy_pattern, a short fixed list, 0.5
kind_weights._d57_comment: D-57: time_hour_near / time_minute_near 2.6 -> 3.4 and time_bad_hour / time_bad_minute 3.0 -> 3.6 (their protected 170 / 178 per 25k, with the smaller `other` group), and so zip_wrong_length 9.0 -> 10.0 (protected 559, which shares the mixed pools with them); fin_with_hyphen 2.0 (M3: ~150 dashed after the 2nd or 4th character, half of the kind); ipv4_three_octets 1.5 -> 2.0 (decoy_pair's `other` group, which drew half of them, gives room to the age pairs; protected 100 per 25k); policy_city_in_brand 1.5 (S3: ~300 quoted brands from a town word per 25k)

label_kind_weights._comment: D-57 S5: a factor on every look-alike kind of the label, in the least-used choice (the VÖEN, FIN, ID card, passport, CVV and licence look-alikes the new kinds diluted)

protected._comment: D-52d: protected quotas, per 25,000 documents (scaled to the build). contrast_subs is checked when quotas.json loads (contrast share x the sub-family's weight); kinds and contexts are checked by --stats on the build. v3's counts from a 25k build at 39dc5be; time look-alikes +15% over v3 to balance R10 (#91 item 4)
protected._d57_comment: D-57 S7: ipv6_mac and licence_id floors 585 -> 600 (v4.2 had 592: the thinnest margin); contrast 0.077 gives 640

kinds._v42: v4.2 fix list: the near misses and the A5 groups, 15-20% under the 30k build so small builds have slack

ipv4._comment: v4.1 (#91 items 2-3, D-52b priority): one_digit_rate, a real IPv4's chance of two to four one-digit octets (values.ipv4_one_digit); second_real_rate, a cross_anchor IPv4 document's chance of a second real IPv4 beside the look-alike and its valid twin (real values ahead of look-alikes)
ipv4._open_end_comment: D-56a (1): a real IPv4 sentence's chance of ending with `;` or nothing, then a line break (v4.1 split IPs without a final period; every IP the targeted data added ended with `.`); also net_context's sentences

key_placeholder._comment: v4.1 A5 (builder._family_key_placeholder, v3_shadow_shapes.md lead 5): real_key_rate, a document's chance of a real private key beside the placeholder block; one_line_rate, the block flattened onto one line.

time_seconds._comment: builder._family_time_seconds (v3_shadow_shapes.md lead 1). sub_weights: prose `saat 14:05:22`, `Saat: 14:05:22` fields, ranges (half of v3's missed seconds were followed by a dash), a time inside a chat line after an unlabelled stamp. stamp_rate: a non-chat document's chance of a chat/log block with line stamps (unlabelled, D-51f). range_round_rate: ranges on quarter hours (`14:00:00-15:30:00`); range_short_end_rate: the end without seconds (`14:00:00 – 15:30`); range_prose_rate: a range in a sentence, else `Field: range` lines; stamp_no_seconds_rate: stamps written `[14:05]`.
time_seconds._v42_comment: v4.2 fix list (24 of v4.1's 51 TIME misses are followed by a dash, seconds-times missed 28 -> 39 of 80): range 0.3 -> 0.45; range_suffix_rate, a range's chance of the case endings (`14:00:00-dan 15:30:00-dək`); range_agenda_rate, its chance of an agenda (lines opening with a range)
time_seconds._d57_comment: D-57 S5: seconds-times closing a range ~200 per 25k (v4.2: 134): range 0.45 -> 0.55, range_short_end_rate 0.4 -> 0.25

form._comment: D-34g `form` family: lines per form, and each line's chance of holding a look-alike instead of a real value (at least one of each per form).
form._date_comment: D-35a: date_rate, a form's chance of 1 to date_lines_max date lines; date_look_alike_rate, each date line's chance of an invalid date (builder.DATE_SLOT_KINDS)
form._v42_date_comment: v4.2 fix list: date_lines_max 2 -> 3, room for the near-miss dates (30 February, month 13-19) beside the protected date kinds
form._extras_comment: D-57 (builder._form_extra), per 25k documents: a real value after its field and, in the same form, a look-alike of the label -- cvv5: a 5-digit CVV after `CVV kodu:` at a line end (M5, >= 150 with the 17 there now; 170 keeps the protected cvv_5_digits clear of its 304 now that decoy_pair's cvv group is smaller), cvv2: a 2-digit CVV (M5), voen9: a 9-digit VÖEN (M7) -- or the real value alone (S5: passports and cards after a label)

clerical._comment: D-34 group 2 `clerical` family (builder.CLERICAL_*): clauses per chain, its length in characters (the probes' 330-660), each chain's chance of a look-alike instead of the value, and the value labels (FIN, IBAN and cards are the ones Run B missed there).
clerical._iban_comment: D-34 group 3 (D-33f prose_iban): iban_letters_rate, a real chain IBAN's chance of letters in its account part (every IBAN Run B missed in a chain had them; 0.35 elsewhere)

cross_anchor._comment: D-51h items 1-2 (builder._family_cross_anchor, frames_v4.py). subs: the share of each look-alike slot, from v3's benchmark errors (short numbers 132, name slots 143, room codes 47, IPv4 47, ZIP product codes 46, MAC fragments 39, IBAN fragments 35). short_labels: which ID/token word the short number follows (VÖEN 60, FIN 31, vəsiqə 21, token/key 20 errors); short_formats: prose, two `label: value` records, a CSV column (VÖEN/FİN/ID only); short_only_rate: the look-alike's own sentence (`... 214 dəfə`, `... 214 saylı`) instead of the pair's shared one. name_labels: the slot word (soyad 63+15, şəhər 51+8, küçə 6 errors); name_kv_rate: two `Soyad: ...` records instead of a sentence. iban_csv_rate: the fragment in a CSV `iban` column.

locative._comment: D-51h item 3 (builder._family_locative): the label of the first sentence (cards 128 benchmark errors with VÖENs, mostly cards), a second sentence of another label, and the first sentence's chance of a look-alike of the same label in the same sentence (wrong length or format, never a checksum-only difference).

slot_invalid._v41_comment: v4.1 (D-52d): TIME 2.0 -> 4.5 and ZIPCODE 1.0 -> 6.0, the protected time and zip_wrong_length look-alikes after their label word (time +15% over v3 to balance R10)
slot_invalid._comment: D-51h item 9 (builder._family_slot_invalid): label_weights, each label's share of the family (TIME doubled for the calendar sentences of the coverage report section 5 item 10; ZIPCODE, item 7, a 2-digit number after a ZIP word); prose_rate, the share written as one sentence twice (else two `label: value` records).
slot_invalid._v42_comment: v4.2 fix list: DATE 1.0 -> 3.0 and AZ_FIN 1.0 -> 1.5 for the C4 near misses (30 February, month 13-19, the A12B34 dummy); new IBAN, AZ_DRIVER_LICENSE_NUMBER and ICCID slots (A5: IBAN-shaped short codes, three-letter licences, 19-digit codes). No IPv4 slot (v4.2 native review B: a look-alike gets a sentence of its own, D-52b); cross_anchor.subs ipv4 0.09 -> 0.13 takes its volume. The family grows 0.013 -> 0.03 and ZIPCODE 6.0 -> 10.0, so the protected zip_wrong_length keeps 559 per 25k now that form gives a third line to dates

place_verbs._comment: D-51h item 7 (builder._family_place_verbs): the case of the first town (the probe cases), a second town sentence, an ablative surname in the document, and the instrumental written as `<town> ilə` instead of `-la/-lə`.

short_keys._comment: D-51h item 5 (builder._family_short_keys): Ed25519 private keys per document (1/2/3), and the chance of an Ed25519 public-key look-alike beside them.

postal._comment: D-42c `postal` family (builder.POSTAL_SENTENCES): each ZIP's chance of being bare (`1043`), else drawn as usual
postal._bare_no_word_comment: v4.1 A5 (v3_shadow_shapes.md lead 3): a bare ZIP's chance of a POSTAL_BARE_SENTENCES frame -- right after a town and a comma, semicolon or dash, with no index word
postal._zip_word_comment: v4.1 (#91 item 6): zip_word_rate, a ZIP's chance (when not bare with no index word) of a POSTAL_ZIP_WORD_SENTENCES frame -- right after the word ZIP / poçt kodu

edges._comment: D-42c `edges` family: each sentence's chance of an edge sentence (value glued to punctuation, builder.EDGE_SENTENCES), else a context sentence (after a document noun or a verb, builder.CONTEXT_SENTENCES)

namelist._comment: D-39b `namelist` family (builder.NAMELIST_*): the weight of each construction (patronymic lists first: 27 patronymics and 22 list-format given names of the 67 missed), people per list, and the chance of a lead-in / closing neutral sentence.
namelist._line_start_comment: v4.1 A5 (v3_shadow_shapes.md lead 5, part 3): line_start, lines opened by a role or heading word (unlabelled) or a real given name (labelled). named_agent_rate (native review of #90, D): a line_start document's chance that one named person speaks the agent's lines, so the sentence doesn't predict the label
namelist._comment_d51h: D-51h item 6: control_line_rate, a patronymic list's chance of a vacant seat line (`Baş mühasib (vakant)`); control_list_rate, its chance of a second list of departments, organisations, positions or document titles; role_control_rate, a role-word document's chance of a role word + capitalised department sentence; signature_styles, the signature layouts (title_only: a title with no name, the letter addressed to a named person). All controls are unlabelled.

punct._comment: D-34 group 3 punct family (builder.GLUED): each glued value's chance of a look-alike, for the labels that have one (IPv4, FIN, email)

village._comment: D-34 group 2 `village` family: kend_rate, a village sentence's chance of the `<name> kəndinin` form (else the name itself suffixed); descriptor_rate, a control's chance of a village-describing word (else a kinship noun).

minimal._comment: P2-4d minimal-context forms (builder.MINIMAL_FORMS). homograph_name_rate: share of lone/greeting names drawn from the homograph list (Fidan, Dəniz) rather than the name pool.

names._comment: P2-15 (D-23d): share of persons with a foreign name (Russian, Turkish, Georgian, Persian/Arabic, English/European) for ~10-15% of name mentions. Above the LLM path's 0.13 (ValueFactory.FOREIGN_NAME_RATE) because a sixth of this builder's name mentions are homograph-list names, always Azerbaijani: 0.13 gave 10.0% of mentions over 5 seeds.
names._variant_rate_comment: v4.2: the per-name chance of another spelling or script (values.NAME_VARIANT_RATE stays 0.10 for the LLM path). Some targeted names are minted without a variant (namelist), so the 30k build read 9.4% against the --stats target of 10%; 0.11 brings it to about 10% and gives small builds their margin back

suffix._comment: P2-4c. case_weights: the 13 C1 codes take ~78% (each >= 5% of suffixed mentions); the tier-2 forms from the 2026-10-02 research share the rest. Codes and forms: scripts/piigen/targeted/suffix.py.

decoy_groups._comment: Shares INSIDE decoy_pair. 0.20 of 30% = 6% of documents each for the name and building decoys (the table asks >= 5% each). D-34g: `noun` (the value before its noun, builder.NOUN_FRAMES) takes 0.10 from `other`, whose anchor slot already held 15-55% look-alikes while the before-noun slot held 0-8%.
decoy_groups._comment_d51h: D-51h: decoy_pair 0.2545 -> 0.23 of all documents, so the three groups with a 5% floor go 0.20 -> 0.22 (5.06% of documents each); `other` 0.22 -> 0.16 (the new families add look-alikes of every kind in their own slots).
decoy_groups._comment_cvv: D-41a: `cvv` (builder.CVV_FRAMES) takes 0.08 from `other`: the same CVV sentence with a real CVV and with a 5-digit or sequential (`12345`) look-alike. `decoy_cvv` was still fully triggered; CVV look-alikes already held 54% of the slot after the anchor, but only ~560 were 5-digit and none stood beside a real CVV.
decoy_groups._comment_d57: D-57: `age` (S1, builder._age_pair: a real bare 2-digit age and an age-shaped number in the same frame, ~600 real + ~320 look-alikes per 25k) 0.055 and `noun` 0.10 -> 0.13 (M3 FIN before its word, M4 near-miss dates before `tarixində`/`tarixli`; AGE, ZIP and card keep their v4.2 counts), from `other` 0.16 -> 0.105 and `cvv` 0.08 -> 0.05 (form's `CVV kodu:` lines now carry 150 of the protected 5-digit CVVs per 25k). The three 5% groups keep 0.22.

contrast._comment: D-34 group 2: key_pair (a public-key look-alike, D-34f) takes 0.20; key_pair_private_rate, its chance of a private key beside it (each short key lowers D-27's share of real-length keys: at 1.0 it fell from 43% to 17%); token_look_alike_rate, a token/key document's chance of an image-digest or truncated-token look-alike beside the pair (D-33f contrast_token_key).
contrast._v41_comment: v4.1 (D-52d, the #91 item 5): the sub-family weights hold ipv6_mac and licence_id at 585 per 25k (protected) and token_key/key_pair at their counts; licence_id_generic_rate, a licence/ID document's chance of a line whose context word says nothing (each label 1 : 1); licence_id_disagree_rate, its chance of a Field: value line whose field names the other document, the shape deciding (D-34d), each way about equally
contrast._licence_id_short_comment: D-56a (3): a licence/ID document's chance of an ID card and a licence after short ID words (`ID nömrəsi:`), 1 : 1, the length deciding; AA prefix share (the benchmark's misses were all AA + 7 digits)
contrast._ipv6_extras_comment: D-57 M6/M7 (builder._ipv6_extras), per 25k documents, beside an ipv6_mac pair: IPv6 look-alikes with `::` (~300 with the 100 PII-free), another real compressed IPv6 mid-sentence or after a label (420, so +300 per 25k even with net_context's count held; IPv6 F1 77.8 against A3's 75), letters-only MAC look-alikes

prose._distance_comment: share of placements that take a frame with the anchor 2-6 words away, when the label has one (target: >= 1/3 of all anchored placements)

label_weights._comment: RC4: cards, dates and IBANs were missed in prose; weight 1 for every other label. D-30b: AZ_FIN tripled, with fix_round.fin_right_after_rate, so more real FINs sit right after the word FİN (Run B's LLM batches have 438 look-alikes there and 92 real FINs).

boundary._comment: P2-4b extras, RC5 (boundary fragmentation). Shares of the matching mints or placements.
boundary._pem_comment: pem_block_rate: prose PRIVATE_KEY placements written as a key after an introducing sentence (the rest use ordinary frames); pem_flat_rate: of those, the key pasted onto one line (13% of the benchmark's keys are)
boundary._logline_comment: D-34 (D-33f pem b, D-34f): pem_logline_rate, a flattened private key's chance of being one `key=value` field of a log line between other fields (Run B's data: 1 such key); public_logline_rate, the same for a public-key look-alike (else a block after an introducing sentence)
boundary._pem_max_comment: Ed25519, EC P-256 and OpenSSH keys (119-650 characters). A real RSA key (1,700-3,300) cannot pass the quality gate's PII-density cap in any document under ~6,800 characters, and the gate is not loosened (A2.4); those keys are left to the LLM path (P2-6) and the long-value set.
boundary._pem_long_comment: D-27: family `pem_long`, a share of all documents (families.pem_long) that carry a real-length RSA-2048 key (kinds with 1,500-2,000 characters) inside a long runbook, deployment note or ticket (long_docs.py). The density cap is not changed: the key is 19-22% of a 7,600-8,700 character document, under the longest band's 25%. RSA-4096 (3,246 characters) would need 13,000 and cannot pass.
boundary._pem_topup_comment: at most this many NEUTRAL sentences added after a key until the document meets its band's carrier-word and density thresholds
boundary._touch_comment: prose values wrapped in brackets or quotes: (AZ3710), "055 123 45 67", «...»
boundary._iban_irregular_comment: v4.2 fix list (v4.1: IBAN misses 14 -> 23 on shadow-dev, 7 too narrow, 7 split): a prose IBAN's chance of a typed grouping (`AZ 21 NABZ ...`, first group only, account part only, dashes), values.iban_az_irregular
boundary._keyed_phone_comment: D-34 group 3 (D-33f): keyed_phone_grouped_rate, a phone cell's chance of the grouped form (+994 55 123 45 67) in json, config, key_value and dialogue; Run B split such phones after the operator code
boundary._ed25519_comment: D-51h: ed25519_private_rate, a short private key's chance of being Ed25519 (PKCS#8, `MC4CAQAw...`) rather than any short kind; with `short_keys` it keeps short Ed25519 private keys >= 3 per Ed25519 public-key look-alike.

fix_round._comment: D-30b fix round, from Run B's benchmark errors (shapes only, never benchmark values). cvv_dashed_rate: share of CVVs written with a dash (`12-3`); Run B's data had 0 and found 4 of 80; 10%, not 25% (D-33d: real cards print CVVs without a dash, and the LLM batches' relabelled dashed CVVs add to it). zip_any_rate: share of ZIPs drawn as AZ + any four digits instead of the 253 real postal codes. card_grouped_rate: share of non-prose cards (tables, pairs) written `#### #### #### ####`; prose cards already always are. FINs keep their natural share of all-letter values (D-33b). fin_right_after_rate: share of prose FINs written right after the bare word FİN/FIN, in a generic `{a} {v}` frame (Run B's data: 438 look-alikes vs 92 real FINs there in the LLM batches).
fix_round._slot_comment: D-34g: slot_cell_decoy_rate, the chance that each structured cell (a `label: value` line, a CSV/JSON/log field) of builder.SLOT_LABELS holds a look-alike instead of a real value. Before: one look-alike cell in 30% of structured documents, which left the `label: value` slot at 0.8-19% look-alikes.
fix_round._iban_comment: D-34e: iban_letters_rate, the share of IBANs (every context) drawn as AZ IBANs with 2-8 letters in the 20-character account part (AZ2!n4!a20!c), compact or grouped. Run B's data had none, and every IBAN it missed in the probes had them.
fix_round._date_cell_comment: D-35a: date_cell_decoy_rate, a DATE cell's chance of an invalid date in the keyed formats (json, config, key_value, log), instead of slot_cell_decoy_rate
fix_round._street_town_comment: v4.2 fix list (STREET read as CITY 8 -> 11 on shadow-dev): a street's chance of a town name as its stem (values.street_town; v4.1: 12 of 1,637)
fix_round._year_suffix_comment: D-51i: date_year_suffix_rate, a spelled real date's chance in the DATE noun pairs (`... tarixində`) of the official `-cı il` after it, outside the span and harmonised by the year's last spoken word (locales.az.year_suffix)
fix_round._day31_comment: D-57 S6: date_day31_rate, a real date's chance of the 31st of a 31-day month (v4.2: 1,483 day-31 look-alikes against no real 31st in the targeted data; +300 per 25k asked)

noise._comment: P2-4b entity casing noise, RC6. case_target_share of ALL entities, held below the cap the task sets (8%); CITY is noised most, as in the benchmark (novxani, QaLa).

structured._caps_comment: D-57 S2 (builder._caps_form): `caps_form`, an ALL-CAPS form, header or stamp (~150 documents per 25k: ~450 ALL-CAPS cities and names, ~135 heading controls); father_rate, a patronymic; id_rate / licence_rate, an ID card / licence field; heading_rate, an ALL-CAPS heading word on its own line (unlabelled)
structured._extra_columns_comment: D-57: extra_columns, a container's chance of a column of the label where the format takes one -- S5 access tokens (v4.1 307 -> v4.2 248 cells per 25k), and a margin for the thinnest table cells (D-57's last rule: no label x context count below v4.2)
structured._synthetic_email_comment: v4.1 (#91 item 9): synthetic_email_rate, a container EMAIL's chance of a synthetic test address (values.email_synthetic), drawn before the reserved-TLD rate
structured._contact_comment: D-34 (D-33f fmt_csv_noheader): csv_noheader_contact_rate, a headerless CSV's chance of the probe's row shape: email, ID card, phone and a status word (the targeted build had email in 63 of 478 such tables)
structured._date_column_comment: D-35a: date_column_rate, a keyed container's (json, config, key_value, log) chance of a DATE column
structured._log_phone_comment: D-34 group 3 (D-33f): log_phone_rate, a log container's chance of a phone column (`telefon=...`; 87 phones after = in a 25,000 build)
structured._d51h_comment: D-51h items 4 and 8: id_and_licence_rate, a container's chance of an ID card and a licence side by side when it takes one of them; cvv_csv_rate, a structured document's chance of a CSV table with a `cvv` column (~150 in 25,000), cvv_csv_id_rate its chance of a `şəxsiyyət_vəsiqəsi` column beside it, cvv_csv_decoy_rate the chance of one look-alike cell.

pii_free._comment: D-42c (D-41d): with_decoys_rate 0.50 -> 0.70; focus_rate, the share of their look-alikes drawn from builder.PII_FREE_FOCUS (EMAIL, IPv6, TIME, DATE, ACCESS_TOKEN, API_KEY), which Run B masked 50-100% of the time in shadow's PII-free documents and which our PII-free documents held fewest of
pii_free._v41_comment: v4.1 A5: focus_rate 0.5 -> 0.6; focus_weights, each focus label's weight -- v3_shadow_shapes.md's PII-free false alarms by label (CVV 42, DATE 28, PRIVATE_KEY 23, AZ_FIN 22, SURNAME 20, cards 19, GIVENNAME 15) and D-42c's labels at a lower weight; key_placeholder_share, a PRIVATE_KEY slot's chance of a placeholder key block (the header words v3 masked) instead of a public key
pii_free._v42_focus_comment: v4.2 fix list: focus_weights from v4.1's A5 table (PII-free shadow documents masked, per label: DATE 21, IBAN 14, IPv6 12, licence 11, CVV 10, GIVENNAME 10, TIME 9, VÖEN 7, IPv4 5, ICCID 4): DATE 3 -> 4, IPv6 1 -> 2, TIME 1 -> 1.5, new IBAN 3, licence 2.5, VÖEN 1.5, ICCID 1 (no IPv4: these look-alikes have no real IPv4 beside them, and D-52b item 3 needs >= 2 real per look-alike in prose; A5's IPv4 group is the smallest, 5); AZ_FIN 2.5 -> 3.0 (C4 decoy_fin 40%; FIN look-alikes stay ahead of IPv6 here); EMAIL 1.0 -> 2.0 (every PII_FREE_FOCUS label keeps appearing beside the new ones); PRIVATE_KEY 2.5 -> 4.0 with key_placeholder_share 0.6 -> 0.75, so the key placeholders keep their share of these documents without public-key look-alikes outnumbering Ed25519 private keys (D-51h: >= 3 private per public); CVV 4 -> 5 and cvv_5_digits' kind weight 1.3 -> 1.5, so the protected 5-digit CVVs keep 304 per 25k beside the new labels. line_start_rate: a PII-free document's chance of a block of lines opened by roles and headings (line-start GIVENNAME false alarms 20 -> 46)
pii_free._near_comment: D-57 M1 (builder._pf_near): the PII-free documents (pii_free and pii_free_business) draw the near-miss kinds directly, on top of their other look-alikes; near_miss, per 25k documents -- near-miss dates (impossible day, month 13-19, 30-31 February; ISO in a quarter), short IBAN-like codes (30% of 18 characters), a bare `AZ`, three-letter licences, near-miss times, and the PII-free parts of M5-M7 (2-digit CVVs 80, IPv6 `::` look-alikes 100, 9-digit VÖENs 80); near_line_rate, the share in a `Field: value` line (half, with the business documents' lines and tables more); near_max, per document

targets._d51h_comment: D-51h/D-51d/D-51i/D-27 checks in --stats: Ed25519 private keys per Ed25519 public look-alike, the share of real-length private keys, ID-card prefixes, CVV CSV tables per document.
